_comment_claude: claude_live=true reads the REAL 5h/weekly limits via the Claude Code OAuth token (~/.claude/.credentials.json) - one tiny authed API call per interval, spends ~a dozen of your own tokens. Off by default. When off, the gauge is a self-set token budget summed FRESH from ~/.claude transcripts (the real quota isn't on disk otherwise). The 5h reset countdown is always shown.
_comment_alerts: Show the SAME alerts as your Telegram. Either POLL Alertmanager (alertmanager_url -> /api/v2/alerts, no inbound port) OR receive webhooks (alert_webhook_port, POST /alert). Leave alertmanager_url empty to disable polling.
_comment_forest: Forest panel node-status scene. Set forest_query_url to any Prometheus /api/v1/query endpoint (e.g. a Grafana datasource proxy) to populate it; empty = scene shows NO NODES. Nodes + PromQL default to forest_panel.DEFAULT_NODES; override with 'forest_nodes'. See SETUP.md.
_comment_services: Resource-status panel (#18). Each entry probes an HTTP url (up = 2xx/3xx, or status matches 'expect') OR a 'tcp':'host:port'. 'timeout' seconds. Shown as up/down on the device; empty list hides the panel.
